name: linkedin-animated-infographics
description: Create LinkedIn visual stories with evidence checks, verified identity sourcing, intentional typography, reference-aware concepting, perception preflight, still-first critique, disciplined motion, targeted visual repair, and focused pre-publish QA.
starter_prompts: Run this in autopilot and turn the idea into an animated LinkedIn infographic with a strong visual hook and useful aha moment.
Create an Info-story from this material and choose the best story shape before designing it.
Review this finished LinkedIn infographic and tell me what must be fixed before publishing.
Use the named AI tool identities in this brief and source their official visual assets correctly.
Prepare this verified demo for the community gallery and ask before publishing anything.
release_notes: Version 3.7.0 turns the strengthened design-quality work into a release candidate for ChatGPT and Codex. It adds a blocking perception preflight before still construction, reference transfer through Evidence -> Observation -> Transferable Rule -> Anti-Rule, severity-aware visual-slop pressure, smallest-responsible-dimension repair routing, and the final-frame completion gate that prevents exported animations from ending before finite entrance motion reaches its intended state. The release preserves capability-negotiated autopilot execution, verified identity sourcing, intentional render-safe typography, still-before-motion quality gates, deterministic visual-intelligence capsules, and the self-contained Skills-only OpenAI runtime.
external_prerequisites: Apps Management write access in the OpenAI organization used for publishing
Verified individual or business developer identity for the publisher
Manual country or region availability selection in the OpenAI Platform submission form
Manual OpenAI Platform submission followed by OpenAI review and publisher-triggered publication after approval
